answer_style.en: writing and answer style, including prose, wording, verbosity, concision, structure, and organization
answer_style.zh: 写作与回答风格，包括文风、措辞、详略、简洁度、结构和组织方式

answer_style.en: I prefer concise, direct answers with the main point first
answer_style.zh: 我偏好简洁直接、先讲重点的回答

answer_style.en: I no longer want meandering, verbose, or roundabout prose and wording
answer_style.zh: 我不再想要绕圈、冗长或啰嗦的文风和措辞

answer_style.en: I changed my answer style from detailed explanations to concise answers
answer_style.zh: 我改变了回答风格，从详细解释转为简洁回答

beverage.en: I prefer choosing a beverage to drink
beverage.zh: 我偏好选择饮用的饮品

beverage.en: I no longer choose or consume a beverage
beverage.zh: 我不再选择或饮用某种饮品

beverage.en: I changed my beverage preference from one drink to another
beverage.zh: 我把饮品偏好从一种饮料改成另一种

programming_language.en: programming language, source code, and software development
programming_language.zh: 编程语言、源代码与软件开发

programming_language.en: I prefer using a programming language to write and run software
programming_language.zh: 我偏好使用某种编程语言编写和运行软件

programming_language.en: I no longer use or prefer a programming language for code
programming_language.zh: 我不再使用或偏好某种编程语言来写代码

programming_language.en: I switched from one programming language to another for coding
programming_language.zh: 我为了编程从一种编程语言切换到另一种

music.en: music listening, composition, and performance preference
music.zh: 音乐聆听、创作与演奏偏好

music.en: I prefer listening to or performing a kind of music
music.zh: 我偏好聆听或演奏某类音乐

music.en: I no longer want to listen to or perform a kind of music
music.zh: 我不再想聆听或演奏某类音乐

music.en: I changed my music preference from one style to another
music.zh: 我把音乐偏好从一种风格改成另一种

food.en: I prefer eating a particular food or dish
food.zh: 我偏好吃某种食物或菜肴

food.en: I no longer want to eat or choose a food
food.zh: 我不再想吃或选择某种食物

food.en: I changed my food preference from one dish to another
food.zh: 我把食物偏好从一道菜改成另一道

color.en: color, hue, tint, and visual design preference
color.zh: 颜色、色调、色泽与视觉设计偏好

color.en: I prefer choosing a color for appearance or design
color.zh: 我偏好为外观或设计选择一种颜色

color.en: I no longer want or use a color in the design
color.zh: 我不再想要或使用某种设计颜色

color.en: I changed my color preference from one hue to another
color.zh: 我把颜色偏好从一种色调改成另一种

sport.en: sport, exercise, and physical activity preference
sport.zh: 运动、锻炼与体育活动偏好

sport.en: I prefer doing a sport or training activity
sport.zh: 我偏好进行某项运动或训练活动

sport.en: I quit or avoid a sport or physical activity
sport.zh: 我停止或回避某项运动或体育活动

sport.en: I changed my sport preference from one activity to another
sport.zh: 我把运动偏好从一项活动改成另一项
